name: Gotify
label: Gotify — Gotify REST API
description: Gotify via the official Gotify REST API. Base https://. Docs: https://gotify.net/api-docs. Self-hosted. app_token sends; listing may require a client token (same header). Customer owns the server. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Gotify operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"create-message"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: create-message | list-messages | delete-message. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: message
schema.description: Notification body. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Optional title. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: priority
schema.description: Gotify priority integer. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Message id for delete-message. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: create-message, list-messages, delete-message. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: App token
configurationParameters.description: Gotify application token (X-Gotify-Key) for create-message. Use a client token to list/delete. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Default priority
configurationParameters.description: Default message priority 0–10 when INPUT priority is empty. create-message.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
